proposition.claim:
For any bounded planar Lipschitz domain and 1<q<infinity, all solenoidal Lq forcing yields a W0^{1,q} velocity and Lq pressure.

The fixed-ball trace Poincare estimate with beta average over D_{2R} holds for every Lipschitz graph.

Arbitrary W^{1,q} boundary data admit a divergence-free Stokes solution.

repair.content:
Separate velocity resolvent estimates from gradient/pressure membership; restrict the latter to the domain-dependent interval near 2 or strengthen boundary regularity.
